'''Torimo''' was a [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]]. She operated as a stims vendor aboard the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Imperial]] flagship the ''[[Ziost Shadow]]'' in the command deck [[Cantina/Legends|cantina]].<ref name="TOR" />
